name: node-forge
description: Sabro stand-in for node-forge, which has no fixed release for GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv. Its only user here is listhen (via nitropack), and only to make self-signed certificates for `nuxt dev --https`, which nobody uses. Loading it is harmless; touching any forge API throws. Delete this folder and its override once node-forge ships a fix.
